name: Taiki Kudo
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 Digimon card with the [Xros Heart], [Blue Flare] or [Hero] trait from your hand under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
